tiers.everyday: The Bicentennial Bell was a gift from the people of Britain for America's 200th birthday in 1976. It was cast at Whitechapel, the foundry that first cast the Liberty Bell.
tiers.student: NPS: cast at the Whitechapel Foundry, presented on 6 July 1976, inscribed 'LET FREEDOM RING'; 6 ft 10.5 in across and 5 ft 6 in high (2013 release), note G below middle C, 12,466 lb (the 2013 release says 12,446 lb). It rang from a tower on 3rd Street until moved to storage on 31 January 2013, and now stands in the Benjamin Rush Garden.
